about: What was a world where every man, regardless of his contribution to society, had the same as the other man? Some would say it was the perfect example of how the world should be. There would be no worries about tomorrow. Everyone had what they need. There would be no jealousy, as your neighbour had the same as you did.Humans were all equal. There should be no disparities amongst people. That was exactly what the world had come to.

You can download and play this content on the main PS5 console associated with your account (through the “Console Sharing and Offline Play” setting) and on any other PS5 consoles when you login with your same account.
